name: Comic Panels
description: A comic-book page drawn in code: thick black panel borders, halftone dot fills in bright flat colours, round speech balloons, yellow caption boxes, and a big spiky sound-effect burst, with Bangers lettering throughout.
best_use_cases: Explainers with speech balloons and captions
Big-moment reveals with a sound-effect burst
style: Illustrated comic page: the camera reads the page like a reader, zooming into one panel at a time in reading order, shaking on the big sound effect, then pulling out to show the whole page with the title panel.
